init.description: Adds AgentForge to a workspace: its dependencies, and the sync generator attached to its build tasks

agentic-project.description: Generates an agentic project: a base layer every agent shares, and no agents

agent.description: Generates an agent as a component of an agentic project

workflow-project.description: Generates a workflow project: workflows, activities and one worker, with no connections

connection.description: Connects a workflow project to an agentic project whose agents its workflows call

sync.description: Keeps every agentic and workflow project's maintained artifacts current
